title: tenspark
body:
This is highly optimised and blue themed resource pack for everyone to use , if you have a bad computor you can also run this resource pack easily without any lag.                                                                                        **Features Of the Pack:**                                                       
                                                                     Very Vanilla Like Resource Pack with minor and quality of life improvements with blue-themed cool textures in netherite armour and tools. With different famous anime characters, you can rename the totems for their texture to change (the default texture is goku ) 
It also adds the heart rename textures for lifesteal smps
with different animations on tools , bows , crossbows , golden apples etc . with crystal textures and inventory colour change to blue.

**Reason To Use:**
You can use this for a more vanilla like adventure with some animation tweaks and fancy blue themed tools and armour with drop of very low fps and low lag.

**Depencies:**
For the Totem System And Heart System To Work , you have to install the **CIT RESEWN** mod for your respective minecraft version.
